subject: history_social
passage: Farmers in low-lying parts of southern Bangladesh have long built floating gardens: thick rafts of water hyacinth and other plants, topped with soil, on which vegetables can be grown. When monsoon floods cover the fields for months, the rafts simply rise with the water. Because the gardens keep producing food through the flood season, they make farming in these areas far less ______.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?

explanation.why: The text says the gardens "keep producing food through the flood season," so farmers can count on a harvest even when their fields are underwater. A dependable harvest makes farming less unpredictable, so the blank needs a word like "uncertain."
explanation.A: Incorrect. Gardens that keep producing food during floods make farming more productive, not less.
explanation.B: Incorrect. The text says nothing about how many people farm in these areas.
explanation.C: Correct. Because the rafts rise with the floodwater and keep producing food, farmers no longer have to wonder whether a flood will wipe out their crops, so farming becomes less uncertain.
explanation.D: Incorrect. The text is about growing food during floods, not about color or appearance.

checks.note: Best fit on the text alone.
